mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(user_openid) VALUES(#{openid}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.name category_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_favorites f WHERE f.recipe_id=r.id AND f.user_openid=#{userOpenid}) favorited FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN recipe_categories c ON c.id=r.category_id WHERE (r.is_public=1 OR r.user_openid=#{userOpenid}) AND c.name=#{categoryName} AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT * FROM recipe_ingredients WHERE recipe_id=#{recipeId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT * FROM recipe_steps WHERE recipe_id=#{recipeId} ORDER BY step_no,id
SELECT * FROM recipe_images WHERE recipe_id=#{recipeId} ORDER BY sort_order,id

SELECT r.*, c.name category_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_favorites f WHERE f.recipe_id=r.id AND f.user_openid=#{userOpenid}) favorited FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN recipe_categories c ON c.id=r.category_id WHERE r.id=#{id} AND (r.is_public=1 OR r.user_openid=#{userOpenid})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipes(user_openid,category_id,title,description,cover_url,difficulty,cooking_time,servings,is_public) VALUES(#{userOpenid},(SELECT id FROM recipe_categories WHERE name=#{categoryName} LIMIT 1),#{title},#{description},#{coverUrl},#{difficulty},#{cookingTime},#{servings},#{isPublic})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_favorites WHERE user_openid=#{userOpenid} AND recipe_id=#{recipeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recipe_favorites WHERE user_openid=#{userOpenid} AND recipe_id=#{recipeId}
mapper.select: SELECT cr.*,r.cover_url FROM cooking_records cr LEFT JOIN recipes r ON r.id=cr.recipe_id WHERE cr.user_openid=#{userOpenid} ORDER BY cr.cooked_at DESC
